Job-market sweep for Prabhavit Gupta, Venice-based AI/automation engineer. Today is 5 August 2026. Five sweeps have run. **Do not apply to anything — discovery only.** Return as many live, well-matched roles as you can with working links. Aim for 15 or more rows.

## Why your slice matters
Every previous sweep searched by title or by generic AI-company name. Nobody has searched by **his actual domain**. At FlowSpace he built integrations against **Office RnD, Nexudus and Clubee** — coworking and flexible-workspace management platforms — plus Sendgrid and Google APIs, and he grew a coworking/space-booking platform from 2,000 to 4,500+ users. That is scarce, specific domain knowledge in proptech, coworking software, and booking/marketplace products. A hiring manager at one of those companies would recognise every noun on his CV. Go find those companies.

## Candidate profile (never invent beyond this)
- ~3 years across eight European companies. **Indian passport, Italian EU long-term residence permit** -> no sponsorship needed anywhere in the EU **except Ireland and Denmark, which opted out of the long-term residence directive** and require sponsorship. NOT UK, NOT Swiss, NOT US, NOT Norway authorised.
- Venice-based. **Open to remote from Venice, remote-within-Germany, an office in any EU city, and Spain.**
- Stack: n8n (deep), TypeScript/JavaScript, Next.js, React, Node, PHP/Laravel, Supabase/PostgreSQL, Playwright, Claude Code, OpenAI + Anthropic APIs, Eden AI, Make.com/Zapier/Tray.ai, RAG, LLM agents, Docker, AWS basics.
- Flagship: FlowSpace (Mar 2024 to ongoing) — coworking/workspace platform, 2,000 to 4,500+ users, led Bubble.io to Next.js + Laravel migration on a live product, built AI support agents, CRM lead capture and enrichment, GTM/outbound automations, a scraping/parsing pipeline that grew listings, and **automated bookings via the Office RnD and Nexudus integrations**.
- **No GitHub. No CS degree.** No Java, no Go/Rust, no Python backend depth, no Kubernetes, no Vue, no C#/.NET. **English only**, Italian beginner.
- Salary target EUR 30,000-40,000. Contract EUR 200/day. **Sole trader on an Italian Partita IVA, not a limited company.**

## Your slice: company-by-company in his own domain, plus adjacent verticals

**Coworking and flexible-workspace software** (his exact integration surface): OfficeRnD, Nexudus, Cobot, Optix, Spacebring, andcards, Archie, Yardi Kube, Essensys, Habu, Deskpass, Coworkify, Zapfloor, Kube by Yardi, Salto/Kisi (access control that integrates with these), Doorflow, SwipedOn, Envoy, Robin, OfficeSpace, Kadence, Deskbird, Flowscape, Sharvy, deskbird, Joan, YAROOMS.

**Flex-space operators with in-house product teams**: WeWork, IWG/Regus/Spaces, Mindspace, Talent Garden (Italian), Copernico (Italian), LABS, Fora, Huckletree, Second Home, Kwerk, Morning, Bureaux à Partager.

**Booking, marketplace and hospitality tech in Europe** (same product shape — inventory, availability, bookings, supply growth): Mews, Cloudbeds, Lodgify, Guesty, Hostaway, Smoobu, Beds24, Apaleo, SiteMinder, Little Hotelier, Amenitiz (Barcelona), Bookiply/Holidu (Munich), Lodgerin, Doinn, HousingAnywhere (Rotterdam), Spotahome (Madrid), Uniplaces (Lisbon), Habyt, Cohabs, Colonies, Casavo, Nestpick, Rentola, Homelike, Wunderflats, Blueground.

**Proptech and property management**: PriceHubble, Zenhomes/Vermietet.de, Rentila, Immoscout24, Casafari, Briq, Plentific, Fixflo, Homerun.

For each company: find its live job board (`jobs.ashbyhq.com/<slug>`, `job-boards.greenhouse.io/<slug>`, `job-boards.eu.greenhouse.io/<slug>`, `jobs.lever.co/<slug>`, `jobs.eu.lever.co/<slug>`, `join.com/companies/<slug>`, `jobs.workable.com`, `<company>.com/careers`, `<company>.recruitee.com`, `<company>.teamtailor.com`, `<company>.jobs.personio.com`) and report anything EU-eligible a mid-level engineer with that profile could do. Titles wide open — engineering, integrations, solutions, support engineering, product, automation.

You will not reach all of them. **Prioritise the coworking-software cluster first** (that is where his integration names are worth the most), then booking/hospitality, then proptech. Say plainly which companies you did not reach.

## Verification — read twice
**Ashby posting pages are client-rendered and a DELETED Ashby URL still serves its old page title** — four top finds in an earlier sweep were reported live by `api.ashbyhq.com` and returned "Job not found" in a real browser. **Greenhouse board APIs report closed jobs as live** and the posting URL then serves the multi-job board index; `?gh_jid=` variants serve the index while clean `/jobs/<id>` URLs serve the posting. For every row: fetch the posting URL, require BODY content, and **state your confidence with what you actually saw.**

## Do not report these — already found or logged
Arize, Arkipel, Ascending AI, Absorb, Attio, Avatria, Avery, BearingPoint, Ben, Bullpen, Camunda, Catawiki, Celonis, Checkly, Clera, Codex, Cognite, Cohere, Contentful, Cosuno, Creatunity, Cresta, DADA ENERGY, Dash0, Dataiku, Docplanner, Dust, Duvo, EggAI, Eight Sleep, ElevenLabs, Eneba, epilot, Facile.it, Filigran, Fueled, G2i, Glacis, Goldsky, Goodweek, GRAI, Gensyn, Helloprint, HiPeople, Integral, Jamie, Jimdo, JobLeads, Kairos, KFS, Kota, Langdock, Laioutr, leadtech, LeadX Pro, Lia, Lleverage, Loomya, Lovable, MailerLite, MAIA, Make, Mavriq, Mercura, Mindrift, Toloka, MMDSmart, Moneyfarm, Monterail, Musixmatch, MyEdSpace, NineTwoThree, Novosafe, Nuitee, Oh, OpenHands, Orb, Otonomee, Parloa, peopleIX, Pinnipedia, Pragmatike, Quadrivia, Reaktor, Reedsy, Reflow, Remote People, Resend, Reverse, RevOS, Riverflex, Runpod, salesHAX, SalesCaptain, Satispay, Shippeo, SIXT, Sourcegraph, Starbridge, Stackgini, Sunday Natural, Super Technologies, Superchat, supermodular, Supabase, Sysdig, Tandem Health, Taxfix, TEVEO, tem, The Flex, The Global Talent Co, Tiugo, Treatwell, Twilio, Unframe, Vercel, Viktor, Visma, Wayflyer, Wypoon, YLD, ZOE, Zapier, alago, cargovibe, dexter health, n8n, neptune.ai. **FlowSpace itself is his current employer — never report it.**

## Scoring (total 100)
role match 30 + eligibility and work basis 25 + stack overlap 20 + seniority realism 15 + signal quality 10. **Add a bonus note where the posting names Office RnD, Nexudus, Cobot, coworking, flex-space, booking engines or channel managers** — those are the rows where his domain knowledge is rare. Kill most of the eligibility 25 for UK/Swiss/US/Irish/Danish/Norwegian authorisation or a local-language requirement.

## Output — return this and nothing else. One block per role scoring 55+:

### <score> - <role title> · <company>
- **Where:** <verbatim location/eligibility sentence> · Tier 1 / 2 / 3 · Employee or Contract
- **Language:** <verbatim language requirement, or "none stated">
- **Pay:** <figures or "not disclosed"> · **Posted:** <date, or "not stated">
- **Domain edge:** <what the posting names that his FlowSpace/Office RnD/Nexudus work speaks to directly, or "none — generic">
- **Why:** two or three sentences tied to specific things he has actually done.
- **Watch-outs:** the honest gaps, named.
- **Apply:** <canonical application URL>
- **Verified:** <what you fetched, what you saw, your confidence>

Then: companies checked with nothing suitable, companies you could not reach, a "lost to a local-language requirement" list, and the queries you ran. No preamble.

# Claude Code agent proxy

Outbound HTTPS from this session goes through a local proxy at http://127.0.0.1:36315
(set via HTTPS_PROXY) which tunnels to a policy-enforcing egress proxy. TLS is
re-terminated there, so every tool must trust the CA bundle at
/root/.ccr/ca-bundle.crt. The standard CA environment variables, the system trust
store (where possible), a JVM truststore, the Bazel system bazelrc, the
browser NSS store, and gsutil's boto config are already set up.

## Quick diagnosis

1. Run: curl -sS http://127.0.0.1:36315/__agentproxy/status
   It reports proxy state, which trust and git accommodations are active
   (javaTrustStorePath, toolTrustFailureCodes, gitSshRewrite,
   gitConfigConflicts), and the most recent proxy-side failures.
2. Find the failure class below and apply the matching fix; gitConfigConflicts
   codes map to the git section, toolTrustFailureCodes to the JVM section.
3. Never disable TLS verification, never unset HTTPS_PROXY, and do not retry
   organization policy denials (403/407) — report them instead.

## Failure classes and fixes

### "certificate verify failed" / "self-signed certificate in chain" / PKIX errors

The failing tool is not reading the pre-set CA configuration. In order:

- If the tool has a CA flag or env var, point it at /root/.ccr/ca-bundle.crt
  (examples: --cacert, SSL_CERT_FILE, NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS, REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE,
  AWS_CA_BUNDLE, DENO_CERT, CARGO_HTTP_CAINFO, PIP_CERT, GIT_SSL_CAINFO,
  BUNDLE_SSL_CA_CERT, HEX_CACERTS_PATH, NIX_SSL_CERT_FILE).
- Tool config files override environment variables. If one of these sets its
  own CA or disables verification, point it at the bundle instead:
  pip.conf "cert", npm "cafile" (npm config get cafile), ~/.curlrc "cacert",
  .wgetrc "ca_certificate", conda "ssl_verify", git "http.sslCAInfo",
  gradle.properties / MAVEN_OPTS "-Djavax.net.ssl.trustStore".
- JVM tools (Maven, Gradle, plain Java): when a JDK is present, a truststore
  is built at /root/.ccr/java-truststore.p12 (password "changeit") and
  injected via JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS — confirm javaTrustStorePath is set in the
  status output before pointing a build at it (toolTrustFailureCodes explains
  why it is missing). If the image or the build sets its own trustStore, that
  one wins — import the proxy CA into it with
  keytool -importcert -noprompt -alias ccr-agent-proxy -file /root/.ccr/agent-proxy-ca.crt -keystore <their store>
  or point the build at the ready-made one. Bazel reads the managed block in
  /etc/bazel.bazelrc rather than JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS.

### "405 Method Not Allowed" from the proxy

The tool sent a plain-HTTP (non-CONNECT) request: usually axios older than
1.16.1 (upgrade it) or a tool configured with HTTP_PROXY (unset HTTP_PROXY for
that tool — only HTTPS_PROXY is supported).

### 403 / 407 from the proxy

The destination host is not allowed by your organization's egress policy for
this session. Do not retry or route around it — report the blocked host.
Note: curl hides response bodies on failed CONNECTs; the status endpoint
records the reason.
